Isabella Sisco
Preserved Primary Document • sisco-i1.htm
Isabella Sisco was the daughter of  William Sisco  and his wife, Araminta. She was born in Kent Co., DE. probably in Dover Hundred in
1844
. She appears with the family in the
1850
Kent Co. DE census.  She is, however, not listed with the family in the
1860
New Castle (Appoquiniminck Hundred) census.
On 1 November,
1866
Isabella married Isaiah Durham in Smyrna DE. The minister was William R. McFarlane. Isaiah is believed to have been the son of William Durham and Mahala Songo Durham. Mahala married William H. Morgan after the death of her first husband. William Morgan's son, James K. Morgan, married Isabella's sister, Araminta Sisco.
In
1870
the family is living in Appoquiniminck Hundred, New Castle Co., DE with 2 children:
William and John. By
1880
they are living in Philadelphia, PA.
Based on the census records, Isaiah and Isabella had the following children:
William H. Durham (b.c.
1867
in DE) (found drowned in Phila. in Aug.
1881
)
John W. Durham (b.c.
1869
in DE)
John married and moved to Camden NJ where he became a fireman. He
died on Dec. 1,
1910
and was buried at Eden Cemetary in Upper Darby, PA.
Savilla A. Durham (b.c.
1870
in PA) (found drowned in Phila. in Aug.
1881
)
Olivia Durham (b.c.
1874
in PA) - she appears in the
1900
census under
her married name -Gilbert- living with her mother and brothers John
and Nehemiah in Delaware County, PA.
Emma F.  Durham (b.c.
1876
in PA)
Bertha V. Durham (b.c.
1878
in PA)
Nehemiah Durham (b.c.
1880
in PA)
Nehemiah married a woman named Alice from VA. His occupation was listed
as "driver" and he lived with his brother John at
1628
Ferry St. in
Camden, NJ
I don't have any information on when Isabella or her husband died but, per George Calley, a Delaware genealogist, they are buried at the Glenwood Cemetary in Smyrna, DE.

Isabella Sisco was the daughter of William Sisco and his wife, Araminta. She was born in Kent Co., DE. probably in Dover Hundred in 1844. She appears with the family in the 1850 Kent Co. DE census. She is, however, not listed with the family in the 1860 New Castle (Appoquiniminck Hundred) census. On 1 November, 1866 Isabella married Isaiah Durham in Smyrna DE. The minister was William R. McFarlane. Isaiah is believed to have been the son of William Durham and Mahala Songo Durham. Mahala married William H. Morgan after the death of her first husband. William Morgan's son, James K. Morgan, married Isabella's sister, Araminta Sisco. In 1870 the family is living in Appoquiniminck Hundred, New Castle Co., DE with 2 children: William and John. By 1880 they are living in Philadelphia, PA. Based on the census records, Isaiah and Isabella had the following children: William H. Durham (b.c.1867 in DE) (found drowned in Phila. in Aug. 1881) John W. Durham (b.c. 1869 in DE) John married and moved to Camden NJ where he became a fireman. He died on Dec. 1, 1910 and was buried at Eden Cemetary in Upper Darby, PA. Savilla A. Durham (b.c. 1870 in PA) (found drowned in Phila. in Aug. 1881) Olivia Durham (b.c. 1874 in PA) - she appears in the 1900 census under her married name -Gilbert- living with her mother and brothers John and Nehemiah in Delaware County, PA. Emma F. Durham (b.c. 1876 in PA) Bertha V. Durham (b.c. 1878 in PA) Nehemiah Durham (b.c. 1880 in PA) Nehemiah married a woman named Alice from VA. His occupation was listed as "driver" and he lived with his brother John at 1628 Ferry St. in Camden, NJ I don't have any information on when Isabella or her husband died but, per George Calley, a Delaware genealogist, they are buried at the Glenwood Cemetary in Smyrna, DE.
